name: Racing Assists
source: [AS] Grade table proposal (assists plan I1, vault PHYS-074; owner approved the grade mapping 2026-10-12): Racing = traction control Off/On/Relaxed/Sport/Drift, plus launch control (declared by the grade table, loaded by assists I4) and aero automation (assists I5: the rear-wing law of racing_game core/src/session.cpp with its rg/environment.h defaults [D]; launch_offset_deg 10 is [AS] = the car_hyper maximum-downforce offset 9-11 deg [D]; default_enabled true [AS, owner: Racing = aero automation]). Mode 'on' is the car's own traction_control block. Per-mode values are assumed starting points (plan B1 table), measured against the V6 ordering band in tests/unit/test_assist_unit.cpp.
